pages.title: Depot Bus Section
pages.text: Currently, it takes the form of the Depot Bus Section in “Valley IV”. $(br)The Depot System consists of three parts:$(br)$(li)Depot Bus Section—a 1x3-sized basic structure$(li)Depot Loader—stores items from the Belt into the Global Storage$(li)Depot Unloader—retrieves items from the global storage and places them on the conveyor belt$(br2)These three components work together to enable automated storage and retrieval in the global storage.

pages.title: Depot Loader
pages.text: Receives items pushed by the Belt and automatically stores them in the Global Storage. It can only be triggered by the Belt; other sources are not currently accepted. $(br2) Blue marker; must be placed directly adjacent to the Depot Bus Section.

pages.title: Depot Unloader
pages.text: Retrieves specified items from the Global Storage and outputs them onto the Belt. You can configure item filtering to output only specific items. $(br2) Orange-red marker; currently allows output only to this mod’s Belt and must also be placed directly adjacent to the Depot Bus Section.
